title: Knowledge Digester adapter: API and tool specifications
requested_outcome: Context: the Knowledge Digester (docs/product-memory/KNOWLEDGE_DIGESTER_V1.md on the trunk; SOURCE_ASSIMILATION_V1.md) turns any external artifact into provenance-tagged, reversible Units. Its model is in app/digest/model.py in this base commit (Unit with artifact_id, kind from UNIT_KINDS, title, body of at most MAX_BODY characters, a Location of path and line span, and tags). This objective adds one adapter, the stage that decomposes a quarantined artifact into Units. Adapter contract, shared by every adapter: a module in app/digest/adapters/ (a namespace package: do not create app/digest/adapters/__init__.py, sibling objectives add their own adapters there) exposing NAME (a short string), HANDLES (a tuple of plain-word artifact kinds it understands) and decompose(root: Path, artifact_id: str) -> list[Unit], which reads only (never executes, imports or installs anything it reads), bounds file sizes and counts, returns Units in a deterministic order with exact locations, and never raises on malformed input (it skips what it cannot parse and says so in a Unit of kind knowledge tagged 'unparsed' with the reason). Standard library only. Build app/digest/adapters/interfaces.py for interface specifications. OpenAPI and Swagger in JSON (and YAML through a small, safe reader for the plain mapping, list and scalar subset those files use; anything beyond it yields an 'unparsed' Unit): each operation becomes a capability Unit with its method, path, summary, parameters and security scopes, tagged 'write' for POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE and 'read' otherwise; each schema becomes an interface Unit. GraphQL SDL: types become interface Units, queries capability Units tagged 'read' and mutations capability Units tagged 'write'. JSON Schema files become interface Units. MCP tool manifests (server.json, or tool lists with name, description and inputSchema) become capability Units with their input schema, tagged 'read' or 'write' from the tool's own annotations where present and 'unknown' otherwise. These tags matter: anything tagged 'write' can only ever reach CLIVE behind its action gate. Tests in tests/test_digest_adapter_interfaces.py build fixtures in tmp_path covering every case named here, prove determinism, bounded sizes and that malformed input yields an 'unparsed' Unit rather than an exception. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI, GraphQL, JSON Schema and MCP manifests become capability and interface Units
every capability is tagged read, write or unknown
the adapter follows the shared contract: read-only, bounded, deterministic, never raising on malformed input
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
